stem.en: Why is the symbol of sodium Na and not So?

text.en: It comes from sodium's Latin name, natrium.
So was already taken by sulfur, so sodium had to use other letters.
Symbols are chosen at random, so there is no reason for it.

explanation.en: Some symbols come from an older Latin name, and natrium gives Na. Sulfur does not use So: its symbol is S. Symbols are not random either: each one comes from a name of the element.
